subject: AtlasSecure — packaging & payment exception request (POC)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: AtlasSecure packaging/term exception for strategic POC

Kimberly —

Quick summary: AtlasSecure (identity security provider) is asking for an exception to standard packaging and payment terms to accelerate a POC that could expand into a multi-M USD account by H1 next year. Highlights:
- Deal stage: POC -> PO expected if POC meets throughput targets (target close: end of Q3).
- Customer ask: Dedicated VPC + Private deployment option (adds infra cost), 40% off list for first 12 months, and 90-day payment terms.
- Proposed committed ARR (first year): $480,000 (but with heavy up-front infra on our side).

Why escalate: this is beyond our standard commercial playbook (discount and payment terms together + packaging). Sales is asking for a discretionary exception and quick sign-off so we don't lose momentum. Attached: pricing_term_sheet_v2.pdf with the structure we discussed.

What I recommend (preferred to keep runway):
- Approve 30% one-time implementation discount (applied first 3 months) + 25% recurring discount for 12 months (blended ~28%).
- 60-day payment terms (not 90).
- Limit infra credits to $25k one-time.
- Require signed 12-month commitment and a minimum usage milestone at month 3.

If we can't land something like this, Atlas is likely to push to a competitor or slow the evaluation. They flagged reference customers and security posture as reasons we are the preferred partner.

Alex Johnson from Atlas is on this thread separately — he is pushing for a faster response.

Attachments: pricing_term_sheet_v2.pdf (term sheet), atlas_poc_statement_of_work.docx (SOW draft).

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Folks —

Forwarding Aditya's ask. TL;DR: AtlasSecure wants packaging (dedicated VPC/private) + steep discount + extended payment terms. Aditya proposes a blended ~28% approach with caps on credits and a 12-month commitment.

Quick thoughts I need from finance/legal before I push back to the customer:
1) Financial impact on committed revenue and cash flow if we do 60/90-day terms.
2) Precedent risk: will this set a pricing expectation for enterprise POCs in this segment?
3) Operational cost of Private deployment (networking + security onboarding effort) — can platform ops commit to a capped SOW?

I want to produce an internal exception memo for Rishi to sign off (CFO) and get Marissa's OK on whether to proceed with the proposed counter. Please reply with concise bullets I can include in the memo.

Quoted message below.

—Kimberly

Subject: Re: Request: AtlasSecure packaging/term exception for strategic POC

Kimberly / Marissa —

Thanks for flagging. A couple of quick items before I can sign off: we need a concise financial model and clear guardrails. I ran a quick sensitivity (attached as financial_impact_model.xlsx) and here are my points:

- Cash flow: 90-day terms materially increase DSO exposure for Q3; 60-day is preferable.
- Discounting: I can authorize up to 25% recurring for a strategic POC if we get a 12-month firm commitment and at least 50% of first-year ARR invoiced in Q1.
- Credits/SOW: cap credits at $20k and require SOW with defined deliverables and acceptance criteria. Operations must sign off on the SOW.
- Precedent: add a clause limiting transferability of terms ("pilot exception") so this doesn't become the new default.

If sales can get the customer to accept 60-day payment and the SOW cap, I'm prepared to approve the 25% recurring discount plus a one-time implementation credit up to $20k. Otherwise escalate to me with an explicit downside scenario.

Rishi
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Team —

Attached below is the brief internal exception memo I'll send to Rishi for signature. Please confirm or flag changes by EOD — we need to respond to the customer tomorrow morning.

Exception memo (internal):
- Customer: AtlasSecure (Strategic POC; security vertical)
- Proposed commercial exception: 25% recurring discount for 12 months; one-time implementation credit up to $20,000; 60-day payment terms.
- Packaging exception: Dedicated VPC + Private deployment for POC; operations to deliver SOW capped at $20k and agreed acceptance criteria.
- Conditions: Signed 12-month commitment; invoice 50% of first-year ARR in Q1; "pilot exception" clause added to contract limiting term transfer.
- Financial impact: net present value recovers within 9 months under baseline adoption (see model).
- Approval requested: CFO sign-off (Rishi) + VP Sales confirmation (Kimberly).

If Rishi authenticates approval in a reply-all, I will route the redlined term sheet back to the customer and lock in the SOW. If we can't land the conditional items, we will present a firmer counter: 20% recurring + 45-day terms, no infra credits.

Please reply with "APPROVED" or edits.
